competition.name: Carabao Cup
competition.summary: England's 92-club League Cup. Early rounds are regionalised, most Premier League clubs enter in Round Two, European qualifiers enter in Round Three, and the semi-finals are played over two legs.

matchRules.roundsOneToFive: Penalties immediately after a draw in 90 minutes
matchRules.semiFinal: Extra time and penalties only after the second leg if aggregate scores are level

phase.label: Preliminary round
phase.entrants: Used only when required to balance the Round One field

phase.label: Round One
phase.entrants: EFL clubs and any preliminary-round winners

phase.label: Round Two
phase.entrants: Premier League clubs not competing in Europe join

phase.label: Round Three
phase.entrants: Premier League clubs competing in Europe join
